title: Taxation Important Institutions
definition: Taxation Important Institutions comprise constitutional bodies, statutory authorities, and administrative boards responsible for formulating, administering, adjudicating, and auditing direct and indirect taxes in India.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for GS Paper III (Indian Economy - Mobilization of Resources, Tax Reforms) and Prelims (constitutional vs. statutory bodies, jurisdictions of CBDT, CBIC, GST Council, and Finance Commission).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Taxation Important Institutions.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Article 265, 246, and 279A of the Constitution of India
